result.rationale: The take-private closed on 2026-08-14. Boralex is now private, 70% Brookfield and 30% La Caisse. Brookfield Infrastructure Fund V is disclosed; no named CDPQ fund is publicly disclosed. La Caisse equity and loans are distinct.

identityResolution.name: Boralex Inc.
identityResolution.origin: 1982 joint-venture/legal origin; operating history starts in 1990; Cascades acquired it in 1995.
identityResolution.boundary: One global platform across Canada, the United States, France and the United Kingdom.
identityResolution.northAmericanQualification: Operating facilities in Canada and the United States.
identityResolution.successorCheck: BIF Thunder Holdings Inc. is an acquisition vehicle, not a separate PortCo.

owners.vehicle: BIF Thunder Holdings Inc.; partners include Brookfield Renewable Partners

owners.organization: Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec (La Caisse)

ownershipResolution.equityHistory: La Caisse bought 17.3% from Cascades on 2017-07-27, later held ~15%, and increased to 30% at closing.
ownershipResolution.debtDistinction: Its C$200m share of a C$250m unsecured subordinated loan closed 2025-07-07 is debt, not ownership.

operatingResolution.footprint: Canada, United States, France, United Kingdom
operatingResolution.business: Develops, builds and operates wind, solar, hydro and battery-storage assets.
operatingResolution.pipeline: Nearly 8.2 GW; ~300 MW construction/ready, ~750 MW secured, ~1.6 GW advanced and ~5.6 GW mid/early.
operatingResolution.contracting: >90% contracted for ~10 years on average at announcement.
operatingResolution.customersOfftakers: Utilities and corporate PPA/CfD counterparties; consolidated list not public.

transaction.seller: Public shareholders; La Caisse retained/increased its equity
transaction.stake: 100% of Class A shares; resulting ownership 70%/30%

acquisitionExitCheck.approvals: Shareholders approved 2026-06-04; Québec court order 2026-06-05; all required approvals received by 2026-08-06. Circular listed Competition Act, HSR, FERC, French FDI, UK NSIA and French competition; no separate Investment Canada Act condition was identified.
acquisitionExitCheck.processCheck: No amendment, termination or definitive competing bid found.
acquisitionExitCheck.laterCheck: No later ownership change or exit found through 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: Take-private announced at C$37.25/share with 70%/30% ownership.
